name: countries_110m
title: Countries at 1:110m — Natural Earth
description: Natural Earth's countries at 1:110m scale (admin_0_countries, release 5.1.1): one row per country or territory Natural Earth draws, 177 in all, with its ISO 3166-1 codes, its name, its continent and its outline as GeoJSON text, so a map can draw it with no spatial extension and no network. 1:110m is the small-scale generalisation meant for a world map; small islands and microstates are left out. Join a column of names to it through naturalearth/country_names. Where ISO's code is disputed or missing Natural Earth's ISO_A3 is -99, and the code is taken from its ISO_A3_EH, the code it gives a map to use (FRA for France, NOR for Norway); Northern Cyprus, Somaliland and Kosovo have no ISO code, and carry Natural Earth's own ADM0_A3 (CYN, SOL, KOS). Borders are Natural Earth's de facto view, not a statement by Meridian on any dispute. Natural Earth's data is in the public domain; Meridian prepared this table from Natural Earth's files, and Natural Earth does not endorse it. Made with Natural Earth.

iso_a3.description: The country's three-letter code, the key: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (GBR, FRA), from Natural Earth's ISO_A3_EH. The three countries ISO gives no code carry Natural Earth's ADM0_A3 instead: CYN for Northern Cyprus, SOL for Somaliland, KOS for Kosovo.

iso_a2.description: The country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (GB, FR), from Natural Earth's ISO_A2_EH; XK for Kosovo, which ISO reserves for it. NULL for Northern Cyprus and Somaliland, which have none.

name.description: Natural Earth's short name for the country, as a map labels it (United Kingdom, Côte d'Ivoire, Dem. Rep. Congo), with its accents.

continent.description: Natural Earth's continent for the country. 'Seven seas (open ocean)' is the French Southern and Antarctic Lands.

geom.description: The country's outline as GeoJSON text, a Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry object in longitude and latitude (WGS 84, EPSG:4326), as Natural Earth draws it at 1:110m. Read it as text, or with the spatial extension's ST_GeomFromGeoJSON.
